# Figure for the thesis

Figure 1 (Section 5.5): association between a typical within-country change in each variable and per capita CO₂ emissions, for transport and buildings. The caption and note are written in Word; the image has no title or caption.

Saved as 600 dpi PNG in `output/figures/`.

BLOCK 1 — Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup-figures
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(plm)
library(sandwich)

df <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "cleaned_wdi_panel.csv"))
dir.create(here("output", "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

x_main <- c("urb_rate", "population_largest_city_pct_urb", "pop_over_1M_pct_urb",
            "ln_cons", "ln_density")
```

BLOCK 2 — Effect sizes: coefficient × typical within-country change

```{r}
#| label: effect-sizes
#| message: false

pdata <- pdata.frame(df, index = c("country_code", "year"))

vc_cl <- function(m) vcovHC(m, method = "arellano", type = "HC1", cluster = "group")
fe_tw <- function(y) plm(reformulate(x_main, response = y), pdata,
                         model = "within", effect = "twoways")   # same model as Table 3

# Typical within-country change = standard deviation of each regressor AFTER the same
# transformation as the two-way FE model: remove the country mean AND the year mean
# (exact because the panel is balanced). Removing only the country mean would keep trends
# common to all countries, which the two-way FE model does not use, and would overstate
# the typical change (Mummolo & Peterson, 2018). Same values as "SD within (two-way)" in Table 2.
two_way_demean <- function(x, country, year) {
  x - ave(x, country) - ave(x, year) + mean(x)   # x - country mean - year mean + grand mean
}

sd_within <- map_dbl(set_names(x_main),
                     ~ sd(two_way_demean(df[[.x]], df$country_code, df$year)))
sd_within   # check against Table 2

outcomes <- c("Transport" = "ln_co2_transport_pc",
              "Buildings" = "ln_co2_building_pc")

effects <- imap_dfr(outcomes, function(y, nm) {
  m <- fe_tw(y); V <- vc_cl(m)
  tibble(outcome = nm, variable = names(coef(m)), b = coef(m), se = sqrt(diag(V)))
}) %>%
  mutate(sdw   = sd_within[variable],
         eff   = 100 * b * sdw,
         lo    = 100 * (b - 1.96 * se) * sdw,       # 95% CI (thin bar)
         hi    = 100 * (b + 1.96 * se) * sdw,
         lo90  = 100 * (b - 1.645 * se) * sdw,      # 90% CI (thick bar)
         hi90  = 100 * (b + 1.645 * se) * sdw,
         # Thesis notation, top-to-bottom order: PRIM, LAS, URB | ln CONS, ln DENS
         var   = factor(variable, levels = rev(c("population_largest_city_pct_urb", "pop_over_1M_pct_urb",
                                                 "urb_rate", "ln_cons", "ln_density"))),
         group = factor(ifelse(variable %in% c("ln_cons", "ln_density"), "Controls", "Urban structure"),
                        levels = c("Urban structure", "Controls")),
         outcome = factor(outcome, levels = names(outcomes)))

# Values quoted in Section 5.5 (effect in % and 95% CI)
effects %>% select(outcome, variable, eff, lo, hi) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 1)))
```

BLOCK 3 — Figure 1

```{r}
#| label: figure1-effect-sizes

# Academic style: black and grey, serif font, thesis notation for labels.
# Thick bar = 90% CI, thin bar = 95% CI; dashed line at zero.
lab_expr <- c(population_largest_city_pct_urb = "PRIM",
              pop_over_1M_pct_urb             = "LAS^u",
              urb_rate                        = "URB",
              ln_cons                         = "ln~CONS",
              ln_density                      = "ln~DENS")

theme_academic <- function(base_size = 10) {
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size, base_family = "serif") +
    theme(panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.25),
          panel.border       = element_rect(colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4),
          strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4),
          strip.text         = element_text(colour = "black", size = base_size),
          axis.text          = element_text(colour = "black"),
          axis.ticks         = element_line(colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3),
          legend.position    = "none")
}

fig1 <- ggplot(effects, aes(eff, var)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.35, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = lo,   xmax = hi),   colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.45) +   # 95% CI
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = lo90, xmax = hi90), colour = "black",  linewidth = 1.1) +    # 90% CI
  geom_point(colour = "black", size = 1.9) +
  facet_grid(group ~ outcome, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) parse(text = lab_expr[x])) +
  labs(x = expression("Change in per capita CO"[2]*" emissions (%)"), y = NULL) +
  theme_academic()

fig1
ggsave(here("output", "figures", "Figure1_effect_sizes.png"), fig1,
       width = 16, height = 8.5, units = "cm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```
